rec: Teleport to PoH with a clockwork table
rewards: Ability to use the Penguin Agility Course

st.t: Talk to Larry at the Ardougne Zoo.
Talk to Larry again.
s: Yes, I have all the materials.

st.t: Use an oak plank on the firm snow patch.
Use a spade on the bird hide to cover it in snow.

Talk to Larry on the iceberg to enter the bird hide. Watch the left penguin and write down its 3 emotes, in order: they are different for every player. To see them again, use the snowy bird hide before you talk to Larry in the next step.
Talk to Larry again.
Tap the boat to return to Rellekka.
Talk to Larry in Relleka.
Travel to your POH or another POH with a Crafting table 3 or 4.
Craft a steel bar into a clockwork at a crafting table 3.
Craft a clockwork penguin at a crafting table 3 or 4.
Talk to Larry back in the Ardougne Zoo.
Talk to Larry on the iceberg.
s: It looks like a warning message to keep us away.

st.t: Unequip your cape and weapons, then long-press Larry at the Ardougne Zoo and choose Tuxedo-time.
Enter the penguin pen.

Talk to the zoo penguin (only one has a Talk-to option). When it wants a greeting, do the 3 emotes you wrote down, in order, from the emotes tab. You're told straight away if one is wrong, so you can try again. Your quest journal also lists them.
Leave the pen and talk to Larry to take off the penguin suit. Talk to him again about the mission report, then travel to the sheep farm in Lumbridge.
Tuxedo-time Larry in the Lumbridge sheep farm.
Talk to the penguins disguised as a sheep in the Lumbridge sheep farm. You will need to use the same 3 emotes as the penguin from the bird hide cutscene.

Talk to Larry to take off the penguin suit, then talk to him again and choose "Yes" to go to the Ardougne Zoo. With your hands and cape slot empty, long-press Larry, choose Tuxedo-time and enter the penguin pen. If you have the Ring of Charos (a), wear it, talk to the zoo penguin and use the lines below. If you have a raw cod instead, use it on the zoo penguin. Choose "The penguins in Lumbridge refuse to talk to me.", then the line saying you forgot the phrase, then "Sure!".
s: The penguins in Lumbridge refuse to talk to me.
I must have left the outpost before they gave out the phrase.

st.t: Talk to Larry to take off the penguin suit, then make your own way back to the sheep farm in Lumbridge, as Larry won't teleport you this time. Long-press Larry there, choose Tuxedo-time, then speak to the sheep-penguins again.
Talk to Fred the Farmer without the penguin suit.
s: I need to talk to you about penguins.

st.t: Run north between the first field of cows and the mill to the dairy cow, shown by the dairy icon on the map. Long-press the dairy cow and choose to steal a cowbell.
Long-press Larry at the sheep farm and choose Tuxedo-time to get back in the penguin suit. Speak to the sheep-penguins once again to learn about the outpost.
Tell Larry about the outpost and travel back to the iceberg.
Jump in the penguin suit and talk to the KGP Agent on the north-west part of the iceberg. Do the same 3 emotes, in order. If he asks for the password, it's cabbage.
Talk to Noodle.
Give Noodle the swamp tar to get an ID card and a mission report.
Talk to the KGP Agent again.
Enter the avalanche.
Talk to the KGP Agent in the first room to the west of the entrance.
Enter the door to the west of the KGP Agent, then go through the north door and walk north outside to the agility course.
Climb down into the water, avoid the moving ice and climb out on the stepping stone at the end. Jump across the stones, use Tread-softly across the icicles, then use Cross Ice to get up the hill.
After you slide down the hill, talk to the Agility Instructor.
Return to Larry to tell him about the penguin army. You can quickly return to him by removing the penguin suit.
Long-press Larry and choose Tuxedo-time, then enter the avalanche again. Talk to the KGP Agent by the control panel at the end of the main hall, then talk to Ping or Pong in the room to the east.
Leave the outpost and take off the penguin suit. Use the mahogany plank on the leather to make bongos.
Long-press Larry and choose Tuxedo-time, then enter the avalanche again. Return to Ping or Pong in the east room to give them the bongos and cowbells.
Use the control panel at the end of the main hall to open the control room doors.
Enter the war room and walk a few steps in to be captured.
Kill icelords until you are able to leave through the door to the west. May take up to 3 kills.
Use the chasm to exit the cave.
Return to Larry to finish the quest.
